changelog:
Initial public release with core home inventory management features:

- Track household items in a JSON database with detailed fields (value, room, brand, serial, photo, etc.)
- Generate insurance-ready reports (total value, room/category breakdown, high-value flags)
- Track depreciation by category using customizable rates
- Assign items to moving boxes and produce QR-friendly box manifests
- Export inventory to CSV for insurance or spreadsheet use
- Command-line interface for adding, listing, searching, and managing items
summary: Document everything you own for insurance, moving, or estate planning. Manage a JSON database of household items with depreciation tracking, insurance-ready reports, and moving box labeling.
